entries.title: General
entries.description: I have been working in design since 2009, creating layouts for newspapers and books. Since 2011, I have been involved in commercial design, working in publishing houses and printing companies. Since 2014, I have been focusing on digital product design, layout, and frontend development. In teams, I represent two competencies: designer and frontend developer.

entries.title: Design
entries.description: Prototyping interfaces based on hypotheses and user experience analysis. Generating hypotheses based on user data from analytics services. Designing interaction scenarios between users and the product. Creating and maintaining a component library and design tokens as part of the design system. Writing interface texts in an informative style, aligned with the product's tone of voice.

entries.title: Frontend
entries.description: Development and maintenance of: product interfaces, client-side logic, API interactions, component libraries, and npm packages.

entries.title: Markup development
entries.description: HTML5, semantic markup, CSS, Less, SCSS, PostCSS, TailwindCSS. BEM, Mobile-first, responsive and cross-browser layout. Basic animation.

entries.title: Development
entries.description: Working with Jamstack. Setting up and integrating a Headless CMS into the project. Configuring infrastructure for local development and deploying the project on a VPS in Docker. Setting up internal and external routing, including SSL. Configuring CI/CD and building the project. SEO analysis and project optimization.
